title: Spacetime torsion fixes the mass and spin of gravitationally produced dark matter
summary: The gravitational production of dark matter from stochastic gravitational waves requires the produced fermion to acquire a mass by unspecified late-time physics. We show that this mass is supplied by spacetime torsion alone -- no Higgs sector and no free mass parameter.
